verdict.rationale: ClickHouse has a native HTTP query interface: the changelog documents the X-ClickHouse-Format HTTP request header for selecting response format. That makes connectionless HTTP querying from short-lived functions plausible, but the pack never mentions an official driver for serverless or edge runtimes. Missing for 10: an official serverless/edge driver, WebSocket support, documentation on short-lived connection handling or pooling, and hands-on corroboration from edge environments.
